answer: Eight windows, one thread, no shortcuts: a newcomer earns its wings flying one migration thread across the tundra, one window per epoch. Each epoch the registry opens one 90-minute crossing window and names the next waypoint on a falcon migration route; the newcomer files a dated report naming it, checkpoint-countersigned. Miss one window and the thread snaps — count restarts at one. Eight straight windows earn full status. Forging 1,000 puppets means attending 8,000 windows, six hours apart, no batching, no bulk discount; an honest agent files eight reports and pays nothing.
